criteria.text: With eight available tasks and a five-task iteration cap, token exhaustion after the third selected task executes exactly three tasks and emits a budget warning.
The combined cap-and-budget path records exactly two budget-skipped tasks; the three tasks outside the cap remain deferred and are not miscounted.
The focused backend unit test, formatting, lint, pnpm type-check, and pnpm build pass without a live model call.
